description: Live check of an external connector (ADR-0013 step 6). Releases livecheck:receipt to the check endpoint only with a signed approval from a trusted person for that target. The endpoint acts on nothing; it answers with a receipt.

outcome.reason: Receipt approved by a trusted person for this target.
A receipt needs a signed approval for this target in signals.approvalArtifact, with receiptApproved true.
